name: Texas A&M Corpus Christi University Direct Entry

programs.title: Direct Admit Graduate
programs.summary: Depending on your academic and English language level, you may be eligible for direct entry to Texas A&M-Corpus Christi. You must meet the standard entry requirements for the University.

programs.title: Direct Admit Undergraduate
programs.summary: Depending on your academic and English language level, you may be eligible for direct entry to Texas A&M-Corpus Christi. You must meet the standard entry requirements for the University.

description: Live and study in a tropical location, at the only university in the nation on its own island. Located along the Gulf of Mexico, you will enjoy a friendly community and rich culture. Relax on campus under palm trees, and explore all this amazing setting has to offer.
